The annual operating and maintenance (O&M) cost has been estimated based on the following considerations: • O&M cost has been calculated based on an annual capture volume of 2.8 mtpa with availability for 8,000 hours. • Natural gas cost for boiler and CHP operation has been estimated with a long-term forecast of NG price, i.e., 5.0 US$/MMBtu. • Energy content loss due to CO conversion to hydrogen is taken care of to produce the same power in the existing powerhouse. • BFG entering the system and H -rich fuel to power plant have been priced based on natural gas, 2 i.e., 5 US$/MMBtu. • Twenty persons on payroll have been estimated to operate the project. • Admin and works overhead have not been considered since the project will synergize with the Attachment-7: Initial Engineering Design and Cost Estimate 25 DE-FE0031937 / 0009 existing operations at Burns Harbor. • Solvent and chemical cost is based on inputs from the technology licensor. • Maintenance cost and Property tax & insurance cost are considered as 3% and 2% of total plant cost, respectively.
